headlines.title: Progressive Democrat scores narrow victory in Michigan primary
headlines.description: Abdul El-Sayed's projected victory over Rep. Haley Stevens delivers another win for progressives in the battle over the Democratic Party's direction, setting up a closely watched general election in Michigan. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: FDA approves 1st mRNA flu shot, from Moderna
headlines.description: The vaccine, called mFlusiva, was approved for older adults. In trials, it was found to be about 27% more effective than a standard flu shot.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños at Chipotle and Qdoba expands to 27 states
headlines.description: Chipotle and Qdoba say they have removed the jalapeños from their restaurants.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak has expanded to six more states
headlines.description: A massive cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to shredded iceberg lettuce has expanded to an additional six states, according to a source familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Firefighters are working 16-hour shifts as they battle the Spokane Complex Fire
headlines.description: The Old Trails and Autumn Lane fires were each 13% contained Wednesday, and the Fairview fire was 5% contained, according to fire officials.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
